Ericsson Cradlepoint · NCOS SDK sample

TCPdumpster

Capture packets on an Ericsson Cradlepoint router from a web page. Pick an interface, set a filter, watch decoded packets stream in, and download a PCAP file for Wireshark.

WAN, LAN, and Wi-Fi monitor

Only active interfaces are listed, and a refresh button finds newly activated ones.

Capture filters you can check

Type a BPF filter and verify it before you start. Count and timeout limit how long it runs.

Take it to Wireshark

Download the capture as a PCAP file named after the router and the time.

Run a capture, live

Press Play walkthrough for a guided tour, or start a capture yourself. Packets shown are illustrative.
Capture settings
0 means no limit. The router needs a count or a timeout, so with both at 0 the app uses 600 seconds.
For example, host 192.168.1.10 and tcp port 53.
Does not apply to Wi-Fi captures, which are layer 2 frames already.

How it works

The page talks to a small server in the app, and the app uses the router's own capture service.

Interface list

Connected WAN devices, LAN ports with link up, and a monitor interface for each enabled Wi-Fi radio.

Count and timeout

The router rejects a capture with no count and no timeout, so the app uses a 600 second timeout in that case.

Wi-Fi monitor mode

The app puts radios in monitor mode as needed and returns them to their previous state when the capture ends.

PCAP download

The capture is kept for download, named with the router name and a timestamp.

See it in the app

SDK Data settings

One optional field sets the web port.

SettingRequiredDefaultWhat it does
tcpdumpster_web_portNoFirst free port from 8000, then savedWeb UI port (1024 to 65535). If set, the app uses exactly that port, retrying for about 10 seconds if it is busy. Delete it and restart to pick a port automatically again.
  • Set it in Ericsson NetCloud Manager under the device or group's SDK Data, then restart the app.
  • Open the page at http://router_ip:<port>. The port is in the app log, for example "Web server started on port 8000".
  • For LAN clients, add a firewall zone forwarding rule from the Primary LAN Zone to the Router Zone.
  • If the field is not a number from 1024 to 65535, or the port stays busy, the app stops itself and logs why.
  • The Wi-Fi channel and channel width options appear only when a Wi-Fi monitor interface is selected. Capture filter verification does not handle Wi-Fi specific filters.
  • Needs router firmware 7.26 or later.
